A '''clone trooper captain''' served under the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[K'Kruhk]] and [[Sian Jeisel]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during the waning days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Dark Times" />

==History==
After serving in the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|siege]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that same year, the captain, along with the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]], were ambushed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. This forced them to flee to the [[Bogden system/Legends|Bogden system]]&mdash;eventually taking them to the world of [[Bogden 3]]&mdash;in their damaged [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle]]. Once the group safely arrived at Bogden, the clone captain and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] made a stop to repair the ship before taking a lunch break.<ref name="Dark Times" />

During this, the clone captain received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]&mdash;which deemed all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as traitors&mdash;from [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As instructed, the clone captain [[Massacre on Bogden 3|opened fire]], along with the rest of his troopers, on the Jedi surrounding them, which included the [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] of the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]]. The clone captain was subsequently killed by K'Kruhk in retaliation.<ref name="Dark Times" />
